Two trailer formats exist in this repo: 'N/N checks passed' (19 suites) and 'smoke:<name> — N checks, 0 failures' / 'N checks, 0 failures' (10 suites). ALL 29 trailers agreed EXACTLY with the anchored count. Zero disagreements.
method.failClassification: Every line containing the substring FAIL in every one of the 29 logs was read individually and classified. TOTAL FAIL-CONTAINING LINES: 7. (a) 4 are genuine PASS CHECK LINES whose descriptive text happens to contain the word FAIL/FAILS/FAILING: content-generation:64 'P9.F4 the SAME review FAILS a homepage-only site with one route-uncovered ERROR per untouched route'; content-injection:74 '19.1.4b far-section duplicate is a NON-FAILING remnant (mockup shape)'; content-injection:95 '§17 intentional overflow makes layout QA FAIL'; content-injection:127 '§1 a conflicting recombination FAILS the run'. The anchored PASS regex correctly counts all 4 as passes. (b) 3 are NOT check lines at all: content-injection:87 and :89 are '[content:qa]   FAIL — unslotted duplicate text desync: ...' diagnostics printed by the DELIBERATE NEGATIVE FIXTURE (they carry a [content:qa] prefix, so they do not match the anchored FAIL regex), and sitespec:278 is the section heading '§90 a pattern whose trigger is not in the tree FAILS the compile'. (c) 0 are real check failures. smoke:e2e contained ZERO FAIL-containing lines.
